business_scope.primary_industry_name: Motion Picture International Copyright Distribution and Licensing

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Companies regime under unitary national law)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law with French Civil Law heritage, unitary national application)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 3 April 2006, in force)
Vanuatu-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (signed 2006, in force)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, in force from 13 December 2020)
World Trade Organization Membership (Vanuatu acceded 24 August 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Act No. 24 of 1992 (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2020 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 4 of 2000 (as amended); Financial Services Authority Act No. 34 of 2016; VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register Directive (as amended).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport for each UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in jurisdiction of origin of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu acceded to Convention 30 April 2008; entry into force 30 January 2009)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or licensed bank, with notarization by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (consular legalization acceptable for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming business character and no adverse conduct
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank maintaining the account relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct correspondence to registered agent (no apostille required)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (or Certificate of Incumbency) for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or registered agent of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Copy of extract of the beneficial ownership register underlying the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate shareholder's registered agent or official registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories must be screened against the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit domestic watchlists before appointment; politicians and state-owned enterprise officers are classified as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and trigger enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and source-of-funds/source-of-wealth verification under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2020.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies e-Registry - corporate name reservation and approval portal (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin characters and may use English, French, or any other language rendered in Latin script; a statutory suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Inc', or 'SA' must terminate the name as required under section 7 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; non-Latin scripts are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected by the Registrar of International Companies, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Financial Services Commissioner within 14 days of the rejection notice, attaching legal arguments for distinctiveness; the Commissioner must issue a determinative ruling; a further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by way of judicial review if the administrative remedy is unsuccessful.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not acceptable as a substitute for the mandatory licensed registered agent and physical registered office in Vanuatu; a virtual business address may, however, be utilized as a supplementary service address for this low-risk film licensing vehicle.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: quantified risk of 5% or less of an unannounced physical inspection for a passive independent film licensing International Company; the registered agent's licensed premises carry the residual routine inspection exposure.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff for International Companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office initial setup and annual administration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk international IP licensing vehicles

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC due diligence, UBO verification, and sanctions screening compliance package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed VFSC registered agent / reporting entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing compliance service fee under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2020

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory compliance filing fee for the beneficial ownership register

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), ss. 4 (Incorporation), 6 (Memorandum and Articles), 12 (Certificate of Incorporation), 33 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), and 44 (Directors and Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Combined) together with Form IC-01 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; one share of no-par value (or US$1) is deemed fully paid and no escrow deposit or capital verification is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers’ application for shares be and is hereby approved, and that 1,000 ordinary shares be allotted to the initial subscriber for US$1.00 paid-up capital. RESOLVED THAT the registered office and registered agent located at VFSC-approved address, Port Vila, Vanuatu, be and are hereby adopted as the company’s legal seat and authorized agent for service of process. RESOLVED THAT the incorporation filing is ratified and the Managing Director and Company Secretary are appointed, with authority to open bank accounts, execute film licensing agreements, and file all statutory returns under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Clearance and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through a licensed registered agent. Ensure the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, includes the compulsory 'International Company' or 'IC' suffix, and complies with VFSC prohibitions on restricted terms.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name in English (with IC suffix)
Copy of passport of beneficial owner and director
Registered agent engagement letter and consent form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried or rejected, promptly file an alternative name reservation via the same licensed agent, paying any re-filing fee only where the first reservation committed the fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Memorandum, Articles, and Statutory Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent files the incorporated Form IC-01, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, a notarized Declaration of Compliance, and the agent’s current certificate of authorization. Confirm that the document package specifies limited liability and the intended independent film copyright distribution scope.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (two original copies or PDF via e-Filing)
Statutory Declaration of Compliance by the registered agent
Consent to act as registered agent and registered office address
Proof of payment of annual franchise tax and filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises a technical objection, the agent must make the requested amendment to the Memorandum or Articles and resubmit electronically within 3 business days; no new filing fee applies if the application was timely originally submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Services and Finance Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit evidence of completion of all required onboarding checks, including final AML/KYC clearance of the shareholder and director. Pay the official incorporation fee and first-year franchise tax by wire transfer to VFSC’s designated treasury account or through the licensed agent’s client account. Retain the payment receipt.
required_dossiers: AML/KYC file of ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
Bank or wire transfer confirmation of VFSC fee payment
Certified proof of legal professional due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not automatically reconciled, contact VFSC Finance with the SWIFT reference and agent cover letter; VFSC will reconcile within 2 business days and restore processing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Company Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, together with a certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles. Verify that the Certificate states the company number, incorporation date, and that the company is limited by shares.
required_dossiers: Approved Form IC-01 and accompanying documents
VFSC endorsement sheet indicating no deficiency or waiver
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical error in company name, number, or date, submit a written rectification request with the original Certificate and a notarized statutory declaration; VFSC will issue an amended Certificate at no additional government fee within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions and Statutory Officer Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry (Officer Filing Section); Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board of directors to approve the share allotment, adopt the registered office, appoint a Managing Director and Company Secretary, and approve official banking/maintenance instructions. The agent must file a Notice of Appointment of Directors and Secretary (Form IC-05) after the meeting, along with the registered agent’s confirmation of the corporate file.
required_dossiers: Minutes (draft or executed) of the first board meeting
Form IC-05 (Notice of Directors and Secretary)
Signed consent forms of appointed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the officer filing is rejected due to incomplete information, correct the director/secretary details and resubmit Form IC-05 through the agent within the 30-day statutory window; late filing penalties are avoided by attaching proof of prior submission.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (no sector-specific licensing); Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce (for voluntary business license only)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license required for international companies engaged in independent film copyright distribution and licensing when no local sale of goods or services occurs; a voluntary Business License may be obtained solely for administrative convenience.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Office-based, non-manufacturing, intangible licensing activity with no physical industrial installation in Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; zero wastewater, zero volatile organic compound emissions, and no hazardous waste generation. Any incidental electronic equipment must comply with Vanuatu’s National E-Waste Guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not separately required as the registered office is a licensed registered agent’s address meeting fire safety and building occupancy standards. The company maintains no physical workplace, plant, or warehouse in Vanuatu; if a physical office is established later, fire safety certification and a structural occupancy certificate will be mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.vu)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt from Vanuatu national income tax; no income tax TIN or VAT ID is issued. A foreign IC is not required to register with Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue unless it undertakes physical import or export clearance, in which case a one-time Customs importer/exporter registration code is obtained via the ASYCUDA World portal. For pure offshore film licensing and royalty receipts, no statutory TIN procurement is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist. Vanuatu imposes no national income tax and does not distinguish between transparent and entity-level taxed structures; the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) grants the IC an unconditional statutory exemption from all Vanuatu taxes, with no election required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No broad-based VAT/GST/sales-and-use tax; indirect taxation is limited to import customs duties, excise duties on specified goods, and border fees
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — Vanuatu levies no VAT/GST; there is no turnover-based indirect tax registration threshold. Customs registration is event-based, triggered per import/export transaction regardless of value.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, or digital stamping mandate applies. Customs declarations and clearance are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World single-window system; commercial invoices and supporting documents are submitted periodically for risk-based customs verification, not in real time.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in the traditional VAT zero-rating sense because Vanuatu does not impose VAT/GST on exports. Export goods are generally free of export duty except certain prescribed agricultural commodities subject to specific export duties. Cross-border film licensing and royalty services are treated as outside the scope of Vanuatu indirect taxation and do not require a zero-rating claim.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form CED) lodged via ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill or other transport document
Commercial Invoice and executed Film Licensing Agreement
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank credit confirmation evidencing royalty repatriation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because no VAT zero-rating refund regime exists, no export refund clawback exposure arises. For physical goods, incorrect export declarations or evasion of export duties may be penalised under the Customs Act (Cap. 257), including monetary penalties, seizure of goods, and liability for underpaid duties. Mischaracterisation of dutiable exports as licensing services would not trigger indirect tax recovery, as the transactions remain outside the scope of Vanuatu indirect taxation; however, false declarations to customs authorities can attract criminal sanctions and revocation of customs clearance privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), Port Vila; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately supervises International Companies and corporate service providers. No distinct foreign exchange administration department exists; exchange-control powers are exercised by the RBV through authorised dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates an open and broadly non-restrictive foreign exchange environment for non-resident International Companies. The Vatu (VUV) is a managed-float currency; current-account income, including film licensing royalties, distribution advances and residual payments, may be credited directly to a foreign-currency account without prior exchange-control approval. Capital-account inflows and outflows, including initial equity injections, shareholder loans, intercompany debt repayments and liquidation distributions, are likewise free of prior licensing or conversion requirements, subject only to standard bank-level AML/KYC verification, correspondent-bank sanctions screening and the provision of a valid economic and documentary chain for the transaction. Profit remittance is not subject to Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax or an advance exchange permit; the practical hurdles are the compliance standards of the receiving correspondent banks and the requirement to demonstrate a genuine copyright-licensing business behind the VU_IC structure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio applies to the VU_IC under current Reserve Bank of Vanuatu practice. Film-licensing proceeds may be retained in any permitted foreign currency and may remain offshore or in a Vanuatu foreign-currency account without conversion into VUV. There is no specified statutory timeline for repatriation, and no requirement that a fixed percentage of proceeds be converted into local currency. The only bank-level requirement is that the underlying licensing contract and source of funds be documented at the time of credit so that the receipt can be classified correctly for AML/CFT reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational VUV/USD Account; Capital Escrow Account for initial subscription funds and large licence receipts pending disbursement instructions
USD Operational Account for royalty collections and SWIFT MT103 receipts; optional Capital Escrow Account for pre-distribution collateral
Offshore USD/VUV Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account where required by the bank for periodic licensing disbursements
Euro/USD Operational Account with local VUV clearing; suitable for European film-distribution collections
USD Operational Account and documentation-driven Capital Escrow Account for Asia-Pacific territories

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low as the primary treasury home, Medium as a secondary collection rail. Vanuatu has no dedicated e-money institution or payment institution licensing regime, and offshore digital EMIs are not authorised banks. An offshore EMI may lawfully collect and route film-licensing royalties only if it is regulated in its home jurisdiction, does not accept Vanuatu-resident deposits, and settles inwards through a direct SWIFT MT103 to a resident tier-1 bank within the same settlement cycle. The IC should not allow the EMI to be the final custodian of treasury funds, because local substance, correspondent access and audit clarity require a VFSC-compliant bank account in Vanuatu. Any use of an EMI should be documented as a collection agency relationship, with full reconciliation and direct fallback to the resident account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no statutory requirement for directors to appear physically in Vanuatu to open a corporate bank account. Remote onboarding is permitted for International Companies when the VFSC-licensed registered agent introduces the entity to the bank and certifies the corporate and beneficial-ownership pack. In practice, every director and ultimate beneficial owner must attend a live video interview with the bank's compliance officer, submit notarised/certified passport copies, proof of residential address, a curriculum vitae or professional biography, and a source-of-wealth statement. A physical visit to Port Vila can be waived; if the bank cannot complete certification through the licensed agent or existing banking references, it may require an in-person or audio-visual identity validation, but this is bank policy rather than fixed statutory law.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu International Company with zero tax status, no employees and only a registered-agent address; the bank may suspect a shell or tax-evasion vehicle.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation and current certificate of good standing; certified memorandum and articles of association; registered-agent undertaking and local office address; board resolution confirming the film-licensing purpose; annual return or maintenance records; audited or management accounts; negative media and sanctions screening report; legal opinion confirming the genuine economic purpose of the IC under the International Companies Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Copyright and royalty flow lacks a clear legal chain; the bank cannot explain why substantial licensing income is payable to the VU_IC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain of title from the original producer/copyright owner to VU_IC through an executed assignment or exclusive distribution agreement; ISIC 5911 licensing and royalty schedules; distributor statements; pro-forma and settled invoices; territory and platform revenue matrix; certificate of an independent copyright accountant or legal opinion; underlying pact with sub-distributors; sample of public marketing and release evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of nominee shareholders, complex offshore holding vehicles or opacity in beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the register of shareholders, directors and ultimate beneficial owners down to natural persons; notarised declarations of beneficial ownership; organisational and ownership chart; passport, proof of address and background verification for each natural person; PEP declarations with negative results; local counsel confirmation that no nominee arrangement conceals a prohibited person or government official in the funds chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Royalty payments arrive from multiple high-risk territories or through an unregulated payment intermediary/EMI.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty AML/KYC questionnaires for distributors and licensee platforms; written collection-agency agreement with each fintech EMI; signed undertaking that all settlement is direct-to-bank via SWIFT MT103 and not to anonymous wallets; monthly reconciliation ledger; bank reference letters from the originating banks; independent sanctions and adverse-media screening report; undertaking to provide transactional confirmation within 24 hours on request.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital should be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own licensed bank account directly to the VU_IC's cleared USD account. The remittance information field should state: 'Equity subscription into VU_IC for authorised share capital; ISIC 5911 independent film licensing'. Vanuatu has no national statutory purpose-code registry; banks rely on narrative purpose text and will map the receipt internally to a capital-contribution category; if the receiving bank accepts ISO 20022 purpose codes, use the code corresponding to an intra-group capital injection or 'ANBC' as accepted by the specific institution. Verification pack: executed subscription resolution, share certificate or register entry, VFSC certificate of incorporation, current good-standing certificate, certified copy of the register of shareholders, source-of-wealth statement, and a letter from the registered agent confirming the paid-up capital character.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For standard royalty, licence-fee and residual payments, use SWIFT MT103 with purpose narrative 'ROYA' or 'Licensing fee for ISIC 5911 distribution rights'. For physical-media sales, collection against a Commercial Letter of Credit is arranged by SWIFT MT700/MT707, with presentation documents comprising commercial invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, copyright-licence certificate, inspection certificate if required, and remittance instructions. USD clearing should be routed through the tier-1 bank's New York correspondent using Fedwire/CHIPS; EUR payments may be cleared through the bank's Frankfurt/TARGET2 correspondent; VUV local disbursements clear through RBV real-time gross settlement. All outbound disbursements must be accompanied by a dated board approval, a settled invoice or counterparty statement, and a sanctions/PEP check on the ultimate beneficiary; same-day SWIFT watering is not acceptable for corruption-risk territories.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts with a licenced Vanuatu bank, up to 12 months, supported by an underlying film-licence exposure and an executed ISDA/IFEMA master agreement.
OTC non-deliverable VUV/USD forwards (NDFs) arranged with an approved offshore counterparty, using a transparent VUV fix, with settlement in USD and no physical delivery of Vatu.
Plain-vanilla VUV/USD or VUV/EUR cross-currency swaps for matching long-dated licence-fee inflows against contracted production or distribution costs.
Vanuatu-dollar / USD FX options or collars for hedging contingent royalty receipts, subject to bank credit-line approval and premium payment from the IC's own treasury account.
Same-day VUV/USD spot contracts and rolling spot settlements for short-term liquidity matching and necessary local operating expenses.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee (Annual Retaining Fee) for an International Company registered under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on the anniversary of incorporation each year; the registered agent collects the fee in advance so that VFSC receives payment on or before the anniversary due date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a 10% penalty surcharge; if the fee remains unpaid beyond the statutory notice period, the company is prohibited from receiving registered-agent services and the Registrar may strike the company off the register and dissolve it

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Certificate and Registered Office Confirmation (agent letter confirming registered office, directors, members, and registered agent consent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent licensed by the VFSC (maintained in the statutory records; not filed with the VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before each incorporation anniversary, concurrent with the annual license fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew the agency certificate causes the registered agent to resign; the consequent absence of a registered agent and registered office is a strike-off ground under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual No-Local-Business and Tax-Exempt Status Declaration (representation that the company has not carried on business in Vanuatu and remains outside the Vanuatu tax net)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (retained in the company's compliance file; produced to the VFSC upon demand)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at each anniversary and upon each UBO refresh or member share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-delivery jeopardizes the tax-exempt status representation; a false declaration constitutes a statutory offence and triggers AML/CFT reporting obligations that may lead to deregistration and personal liability of directors

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None applicable. A Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from audit and from filing financial statements with the VFSC; a voluntary audit may be imposed internally by the articles of association or by a film-financing lender as a condition precedent.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory framework for exempt International Companies; where financial statements are prepared for royalty administration or lender reporting, IFRS or a simplified accrual basis is commonly adopted, and such statements are not filed with any Vanuatu authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must hold a current register of beneficial owners under VFSC AML/CFT Rules and the International Companies Act; beneficial ownership data is verified and refreshed at least every 12 months and immediately upon any share transfer or change in control, with completed UBO confirmation forms signed by each member/director before the transfer is registered.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Members' and Directors' Resolutions
Register of Beneficial Owners (held by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - 1,500 per annum for registered agent, registered office, and standard corporate compliance administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (no statutory audit required); voluntary special-purpose film royalty/IP audit, if commissioned, ranges from USD 4,000 to 12,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no payroll or social security tax on the profits of an International Company registered under the International Companies Act 2013.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are statutorily exempted from Vanuatu income taxation. The only recurring fiscal cost is the annual VFSC government renewal fee assessed on authorized capital. Indirect taxes (15% VAT and stamp duty) apply only to prohibited domestic Vanuatu taxable activity; conducting such activity nullifies the exemption and the registration itself. Tax loss carryforward is legally inoperative because no taxable-income baseline is computed for an IC; the pipeline's 5-year metric is supplied as a default and has no statutory effect.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The sole mandatory annual filing is the 'International Company Annual Return', a prescribed form under the International Companies Act 2013 and International Companies Regulations, submitted through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent on the VFSC Registry Portal (https://vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, computed from the anniversary of incorporation rather than a fiscal year-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return must be filed within six months after each anniversary of incorporation, accompanied by payment of the annual government renewal fee then due. The registered agent must update registered office, registered agent, directors, shareholders and business-activity statements on each filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered name of the International Company as stated in the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the statutory corporate name only; never add a local Vanuatu trading name because that evidences unauthorized domestic business.
Insert the VFSC number exactly; the Registry reconciles the annual fee ledger against this number and mismatches cause penalty notices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date on which the certificate of incorporation was issued.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This date controls the filing anniversary; non-resident principals must instruct the agent to calendar every future anniversary and deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide only the agent's office address with lease or occupancy evidence; an unsupported street address will be rebutted in any economic-substance inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address and licence number of the Vanuatu registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the official contact for VFSC process; a change of agent during the year must be filed and acknowledged by the non-resident board.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Maximum authorized share capital, currency denomination and par value.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The capital can be expressed in a major foreign currency; if film investors subscribe in USD, state all amounts in that currency and verify the applicable annual-fee band.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field B2 (Issued Capital and Share Classes)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of issued shares and shareholder ownership breakdown.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify each non-resident shareholder's tax-residence jurisdiction; an unexplained omission undermines future treaty-relief or Tax Residency Certificate applications.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationalities and appointment dates of all directors and the corporate secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors are lawful, but the non-resident beneficial owner must hold signed resignations and declarations of trust to enable immediate board reconstitution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: AML/CFT register confirming ultimate natural-person owners and percentage interests.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Submit passport-level identification and tax-residence evidence; split-film-royalty beneficial ownership arrangements that are undisclosed will trigger FATF/VFSC scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of intended business activity for ICA and economic-substance classification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 'international motion picture copyright distribution and licensing (ISIC 5911)' and expressly disclaim any Vanuatu market sales, local production, or domestic solicitation. If the IC also holds film copyrights, the entity must self-identify as an economic-substance IP relevant activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment of the annual government fee triggers the Registrar's late-payment surcharge (typically 10% of the annual fee) plus interest at the statutory rate. Continued default leads to administrative strike-off after gazette notice, restoration costs and director disqualification. Knowingly false statements in the Annual Return are a criminal offense punishable by fine and imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no withholding tax, no dividend tax and no remittance tax on distributions declared by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu's comprehensive double-tax-agreement network is very limited; many counterpart states rely on Tax Information Exchange Agreements rather than a full DTA. Where treaty relief is available, the protocol is: (i) apply through the licensed agent to the VFSC/Registrar for a Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate or equivalent exemption certificate attesting the IC's nil-tax status; (ii) certify that the dividend or royalty has not been and will not be deducted against Vanuatu domestic income; and (iii) deliver the TRC, beneficial-ownership certificate and the film-licence agreement to the foreign paying agent before the payment date. Because Vanuatu imposes no outbound withholding, this procedure is relevant mainly to establish beneficial ownership in the shareholder's home taxing jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding on outbound royalties and interest paid by an IC is 0% for both categories; no domestic Vanuatu charge exists for a treaty to reduce. In the licensee's source country, statutory rates commonly range from 10-25% and applicable treaty rates from 0-15%, but because Vanuatu has few in-force comprehensive DTAs, the domestic statutory rate of the source country will apply unless a TRC-supported treaty claim is available.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has not enacted transfer-pricing legislation, and no VUV-denominated Local File, Master File or Country-by-Country Report threshold applies to International Companies. As a BEPS Inclusive Framework member, Vanuatu maintains policy commitments against harmful tax practices but currently imposes no domestic mandatory TP documentation on ICs.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Act, applicable to International Companies and amended most recently in 2021-2022, requires a relevant-activity IC to demonstrate in Vanuatu: (i) direction and management through board meetings held at the registered office; (ii) adequate physical premises and employees; (iii) operating expenditure proportionate to income; and (iv) core-IP management where IP income is derived. An independent film-licensing IC falls within the IP-holding and distribution/service-centre categories; annual economic-substance notification and filing with the VFSC are mandatory. The reduced substance regime applies only to pure equity-holding entities, not to active film-royalty licensees.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Exemption Abuse / Unauthorized Domestic Business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to solicit business from Vanuatu residents, contract with Vanuatu theaters or broadcasting platforms, hold Vanuatu land, or conduct banking or insurance-type activity in Vanuatu while continuing to assert ICA tax-exempt foreign status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the exemption certificate and forfeiture of tax-exempt status, administrative fines and penalty surcharges under the ICA Regulations, strike-off by the Registrar, and recovery of uncollected VAT, stamp duty and other indirect taxes on the unlawful domestic transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced when directors knowingly authorize local activity; directors become jointly and severally liable to defrauded creditors and the Vanuatu revenue authority, may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu company, and may be subjected to a travel restraint pending criminal investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the film-licensing IC as a 'letter-box' vehicle with no board minutes, no Vanuatu management presence, no accounting records of film-right transactions, no registered-office substance, and no annual ESR return for the IP relevant activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties for ESR non-compliance and false substance declarations; repeat failures attract financial penalties scaled to the IC's gross film-royalty income, corrective orders and strike-off. Adverse findings may be exchanged with OECD and EU authorities under information-sharing instruments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who certify false substance filings face statutory fines and imprisonment, personal restitution for creditor losses, loss of professional licensing in Vanuatu, and exposure to re-characterization of the IC as a sham by foreign tax authorities, thereby triggering source-country tax, interest and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring inflated or fictitious 'film-licensing royalties' to strip earnings from foreign production companies, combined with undisclosed beneficial owners, settlement outside licensed payment rails such as Swift Wire or Letters of Credit, or dealings with sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions without adequate customer due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal sanctions under the Vanuatu Proceeds of Crime Act and AML/CFT framework: confiscation of laundered film-revenue assets, pecuniary penalties against the corporate entity, and VFSC regulatory enforcement for failure to maintain the statutory AML compliance program.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly direct sham licensing structures face imprisonment for money laundering, travel bans and international asset-freezing orders obtained by treaty partners, joint-and-several civil restitution for the laundered amounts, and disqualification from acting as directors of any VFSC-regulated entity.
